These entries are concise summaries, and the main subject articles contain more detail. Common misconceptions are widely accepted viewpoints or factoids that are actually false. They often arise from conventional wisdom (such as old wives' tales), stereotypes , superstitions , logical fallacies , misunderstandings of science, or the popularization of pseudoscience and pseudohistory . Some misconceptions are also considered urban legends and may contribute to moral panics . Lists edit In order to manage page size and loading time, this long article has been split into multiple articles.
